entities.name: RRP1B
observations: In breast cancer cells, RRP1B chromatin occupancy co-localizes with TRIM28/KAP1 and CBX5/HP1α at repressed loci; these loci have higher H3K9me3.
RRP1B upregulation, associated with metastasis suppression, induces global histone-methylation changes.

entities.name: H3K9me3
observations: RRP1B-bound repressed loci show elevated H3K9me3 in the reported chromatin studies.

entities.name: TRIM28
observations: Co-occupies RRP1B-bound loci with reduced gene expression in ChIP-reChIP assays.

entities.name: CBX5
observations: HP1α co-occupies RRP1B-bound loci with reduced gene expression in ChIP-reChIP assays.

entities.name: PMID:25092915
observations: Lee et al. report RRP1B chromatin binding, TRIM28/CBX5 co-occupancy, H3K9me3 enrichment at repressed loci, and global histone-methylation changes after RRP1B upregulation.
